# HUMINT

> AI consulting by Dina Bosma-Buczynska. Human intelligence, AI powered. Strategy, implementation, and the bridge between them. Berlin-based, available in English, German, and Dutch.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, approach, case studies, and contact.

- [AI Noob Club](/ai-noob-club): AI basics for women who run their own business, free resources, products, community, meetups and workshops.
- [Content-Assistentin](/ai-noob-club/content-assistentin): Self-paced course in development for creating content faster with AI while keeping your voice, visual identity and originality through reusable instructions, templates and a repeatable workflow. Independent product waitlist, not standalone software.
- [Free resources](/ai-noob-club/gratis): Starterpaket, Edit-Guide and KI-Start-Check.
- [Community](/ai-noob-club/community): Founders community signup.
- [Club contact](/ai-noob-club/kontakt): Workshop and collaboration requests.
- [KI-Workflow-Check](/ki-workflow-check): Five questions to find a practical first AI step.
